api-peak-hours.config.peakHoursDebug.des: Write simulated time, interval changes, state transitions, and notifications to the Extension Host log.
api-peak-hours.config.peakHoursDebugUtcT: Debug UTC time for peak hours
For debugging only. Sets the simulated UTC start time; elapsed real time advances from it.
api-peak-hours.config.peakSoonMinutes.de: Minutes before peak starts to show Peak soon (0-30).
api-peak-hours.config.peakTransitionBuff: Minutes to turn Peak on before its start (0-20).
api-peak-hours.config.postPeakMinutes.de: Minutes after peak ends to keep the status in the yellow transition state (0-20).
api-peak-hours.config.notifications.desc: Show notifications when the peak-hours status changes.
